steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

attacks.name: Sweet Christmas
steps: |!wild| |*Throw|: After this attack is resolved, if the target character is Size 3 or less, it may be thrown |!range_small|.
After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§slow§Slow| and |§stun§Stun| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Street Fighter
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of Size 2 or less within |!range| 2, and throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Too Dangerous to Ignore
superPowers.body: When an enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character targets another allied character with an attack, this character may use this superpower. This character becomes the target of the attack regardless of range and LOS.

superPowers.name: Unbreakable Skin
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
